Wesleyan University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Retained as an additional program if outside the final top-100 ranking boundary.
• The MA is closed to Fall 2027 applications; apply to the PhD.
• Referee invitations are sent only after submission.
• A UChicago degree still in progress can support an English-waiver request.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
An undergraduate mathematics major, or computer-science major with substantial mathematics, is the
expected preparation; no fixed course list is prescribed. The PhD is open for Fall 2027 and does not require a
master’s. The standalone Mathematics MA is explicitly not accepting Fall 2027 applications. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Start the graduate application, select entry year 2027 and the GRADUATE option, gather all college records
and three college-instructor references, and draft the statement of purpose. Request the UChicago English
waiver by email. Submit early enough to trigger letters before the complete-file deadline; an interview may
follow. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor commitment is listed. A campus visit is strongly recommended for judging fit and an
interview may be requested. Arithmetic geometry and number theory are the clearest matches; contact
individual faculty about current supervision capacity. [s1] [s5]
Portal workflow [Unresolved]
The graduate portal provides an applicant-status page after submission. The public instructions do not
establish whether each letter has a distinct received indicator or whether receipt emails are sent. [s2] [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Central admissions explicitly publishes the Fall 2027 mathematics deadline and MA closure. Departmental
application/funding pages are undated and contain older details, so current central rules are cross-checked and
discrepancies retained. Checked November 5, 2026. [s1] [s2] [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
February 15, 2027 for mathematics PhD full consideration. Applications open September 1. Central admissions
prohibits fall applications after March 31, 2027; this outer limit does not extend priority consideration. [s2]
Funding consideration; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
February 15, 2027 is the complete-file priority, including supporting materials and letters, with automatic
assistantship consideration. No separate scholarship or referee grace period was established. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Current official English scores are due by the priority deadline unless a waiver is approved. The mathematics

page includes optional GRE scores among materials due February 15. No separate later score cutoff was
established. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
A specific Fall 2027 admission/funding acceptance date was not established on the reviewed public pages; use
the date in the offer and confirm any interim conditions. [s1] [s2] [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Without a waiver, current official TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores are required by the priority deadline;
unofficial or expired scores are not accepted. The central page publishes thresholds for several sciences but
not mathematics, so do not import another program’s cutoff. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [2027 confirmed]
The current rule explicitly includes a US undergraduate/master’s degree already completed OR currently in
progress. Email an unofficial UChicago transcript to gradadmissions@wesleyan.edu to request consideration
for the exemption; obtain approval rather than assuming it is automatic. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
The mathematics page strongly recommends GRE scores but does not require them. It does not clearly
distinguish General from Mathematics Subject GRE, so the separate test classifications remain unresolved.
Reporting codes are institution 3959 and mathematics department 0703. [s1]

Transcripts and degree records [Conflict]
Provide transcripts of all academic work at undergraduate level or beyond. The department asks for official
transcripts, while current central admissions permits unofficial records for review and requires official records
for matriculation. Confirm the review-stage choice; final admission also depends on completing the bachelor’s
degree. [s1] [s2]

whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters from college instructors familiar with academic ability and performance. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Every admission applicant is automatically considered for an assistantship. No extra standard assistantship
letter or separate funding essay is listed; other awards could have separate rules. [s3]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
The mathematics page explicitly says referees are prompted to upload letters upon submission of the
application. Entering names alone is not the published trigger. Verify email addresses before submitting and
leave time for letters. [s1]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The graduate portal provides an applicant-status page after submission. The public instructions do not
establish whether each letter has a distinct received indicator or whether receipt emails are sent. [s2] [s4]

Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No current public rule for updating a received recommendation or reusing letters across programs/cycles was
established. Ask graduate admissions or mathematics directly before relying on reuse. [s1] [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
The current central graduate-admission page advertises a $46,000 annual stipend, 100% tuition remission for
eligible students and a two-thirds contribution to the Wesleyan student health plan. It does not specify paid
months or a Fall 2027 mathematics-specific offer amount. The department’s older $829 annual health cost and
$40 association fee should not be treated as current confirmed charges. [s2] [s3]
Years of support [Standing rule]
The department states that students in good standing receive support for the duration of their studies. A
numeric maximum guarantee and detailed renewal conditions were not established. [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The department says all applicants are considered and all students in good standing are supported, without a
nationality exclusion. This supports international assistantship eligibility, but confirm the individual F-1
appointment and any teaching-language conditions in the offer. [s1] [s3]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Financial support is through assistantships/fellowships and requires good standing. Public pages do not
establish exact teaching hours, progress thresholds, current incidental fees or the guaranteed number of paid
months. [s2] [s3]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Every admission applicant is automatically considered for an assistantship. No extra standard assistantship
letter or separate funding essay is listed; other awards could have separate rules. [s3]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
The department says additional summer support is usually available for students remaining on campus to
study, and notes subsidized university housing. Summer funding is not promised; the relationship to the
current advertised annual stipend needs clarification. No separate scholarship essay/paper-upload rule was
established. [s3]
Application fee; Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
There is no mathematics PhD application fee; no waiver application is needed. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Departmental official-transcript wording conflicts with central permission to submit unofficial records for
review. The mathematics page’s open-ended invitation to exceptional late applicants is bounded by the central
March 31, 2027 absolute fall cutoff. Older health-cost figures and a broken departmental stipend link do not
supersede the current central funding advertisement. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm General versus Math GRE recommendation, exact SOP prompt/limit/format, letter
receipt/replacement/reuse mechanics, current annual funding months and insurance charges, numeric support
duration, and offer acceptance deadline. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Arithmetic geometry
Christopher Rasmussen
Arithmetic algebraic geometry and computational number theory; elliptic/abelian varieties, constrained torsion
and Galois representations. [s5] [s9] [s10]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Heavenly elliptic curves over quadratic fields
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / arithmetic of quadratic forms
Wai Kiu Chan
Integral quadratic forms, lattices, algebraic groups and modular forms. The newest paper on the reviewed
official list is from 2023. [s5] [s6] [s7]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2023 · Can we recover an integral quadratic form by representing all its subforms?
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / automorphic cohomology
David Pollack
Arithmetic cohomology of higher-rank groups, p-adic variation and automorphic forms. The official publication
page is old; a recent dated paper was not established. [s5] [s8]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: Undated on old official list; not verified as recent · Everywhere unramified automorphic cohomology for
GL(3)
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / homogeneous dynamics
Han Li
Homogeneous dynamics, arithmetic lattices and effective results for quadratic forms; the reviewed personal
research page lists 2022 as its newest paper. [s5] [s11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.

Research evidence: 2022 · On realization of isometries for higher rank quadratic lattices over number fields
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / Diophantine approximation
Felipe A. Ramírez
Metric Diophantine approximation, ergodic theory, dynamical systems and fractal geometry. [s5] [s12]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Metric bootstraps for limsup sets
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
